The '''Elder Council''' was the ruling body among the Red or [[Elders (Rakatan)|Elder]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Prior and during the [[Old Sith Wars]], the members of the council allied with [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> The council also had the duty of making sure that the secrets of the Ancients were safe inside the [[Temple of the Ancients]], which kept others like the [[Black Rakata|Rakatan tribe]] led by [[The One]] from finding and keeping the secrets.<ref name="KOTOR" />
